source.attribution: Japanese word and kanji data from JMdict and KANJIDIC2, compiled by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG), used under CC BY-SA 4.0. JSON conversion by scriptin/jmdict-simplified.

derived_database.note: Derived from the sources above; distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. No copyright is claimed over the source data.

fixture.note: Synthetic original test data only. A database built from it is marked fixture and must never ship in a packaged build.

update_procedure: To update: choose a newer pinned release, record exact asset names/sizes/SHA-256 in this manifest, run scripts/download_datasets.py, scripts/build_dictionary.py and scripts/validate_dictionary.py --require-production, review THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and the in-app Sources text, then rebuild and ship a new installer. Never use 'latest' at runtime or in CI.
